angles.name: Stainless / cast iron switch
angles.survey_source: S1 (n=6,792) 'Which options did they seriously compare?': stainless steel 41%, ceramic 17%, cast iron 13%.

A.label: NO COATING, LIKE STAINLESS
A.headline: No coating, like stainless. Eggs that let go.
A.proof: 4 in 10 Siraat customers compared us with stainless steel before choosing titanium.
A.body: Cold metal grabs your food, hot metal lets it go. Medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, a teaspoon of oil, and it slides. No seasoning.

thank_you.headline: Your 5 gifts are waiting
thank_you.body: Check your inbox. We'll show you the water-drop test that tells you the pan is ready.

B.label: THE EASIER SWITCH
B.headline: You wanted no coating. Not a fight with every egg.
B.proof: Stainless steel is what most Siraat customers weighed us against. 4 in 10 of them.
B.body: Titanium keeps the part you liked about stainless, nothing on the surface. Get the heat right and it lets go. No seasoning, dishwasher safe.

thank_you.headline: Breakfast is about to get easier
thank_you.body: Your welcome email is on its way, with how to heat titanium so food lets go.
